title: docs: note the quest payout query reads 10 PRs on purpose
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a code comment: the quest payout query reads at most 10 linked PRs per quest on purpose
- Process for multi-winner quests (e.g. #15054): close losing PRs before merging winners, so every paid PR stays within the first 10

gist.headline: Ten Bees, One Payout
gist.blurb: A small trail marker now explains why quest payout checks stop at 10 linked PRs. For multi-winner quests, close the non-winners first so the rewarded work stays in the basket.
gist.summary: Documented that the GitHub contribution quest payout query intentionally reads only the first 10 linked PRs, with guidance to close losing PRs before merging winners in multi-winner quests such as #15054.
gist.impact: Quest maintainers now have a clear workflow for keeping every paid winning PR within the query's intentional 10-PR window.
